items.title: Tom Baker interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997
items.q: You were talking about James Morrison and playing with Rolph Harris.

ctx.x: I just forgot what I was going to say.
You were talking about James Morrison and playing with Rolph Harris.
Rolf Harris. Okay. Sorry about that. Where shall I take it up?
